statements.impact_statement: This assessment covers the shipped Extra CODEOWNERS service, not arbitrary programs run inside its container. The affected SQLite FTS5 reader requires crafted database pages queried through FTS5 MATCH. The service creates ordinary state tables; its schema, migrations and queries use no FTS virtual tables or MATCH expressions and do not load SQLite extensions. There is no database-upload endpoint. This covers supported SQLite operation as well as PostgreSQL deployments, not arbitrary SQL or externally supplied databases.

statements.impact_statement: This assessment covers the shipped Extra CODEOWNERS service, not arbitrary programs run inside its container. The vulnerable path requires a scanf allocating character conversion (%mc) with an explicit width greater than 1024. A caller-level review of both native images found fixed numeric or string formats at 30 amd64 and 36 arm64 external scanf-family call sites, except ncurses vwscanw, which forwards an arbitrary format but is not used by the service or exposed by CPython _curses. Additional glibc callers use fixed formats or forward the already-reviewed arguments. ARM64 stack-spilled format pointers were traced to constant data. No reachable caller supplies the allocating character conversion; SELinux %ms conversions are not the affected %mc operation. Call offsets, binary hashes, formats and forwarding paths are recorded in security/vex/glibc-2026-5450-callers.json. Custom FFI, native plugins and arbitrary code inside the image are outside this assessment.

statements.impact_statement: This assessment covers the shipped Extra CODEOWNERS service, not arbitrary programs run inside its container. The service does not use C wide-character FILE pushback. CPython 3.14.7 has no ungetwc call. In both Python/native ELF dependency closures, the only external ungetwc importer is libstdc++; its consumers are greenlet and its test extension, which use C++ allocation, strings and exception support, not wide streams. The amd64 ungetwc call sites are stdio_sync_filebuf<wchar_t> operations. Python text decoding is not this C wide-stream path.

statements.impact_statement: This assessment covers the shipped Extra CODEOWNERS service, not arbitrary programs run inside its container. The affected API is PCRE2 DFA matching. The named Debian libpcre2-8-0 library is outside the Python/native ELF dependency closure on both architectures. Application policy matching uses Python re. The arm64 psycopg wheel has a separate private PCRE2 dependency through its private SELinux library; that library imports ordinary matching, not pcre2_dfa_match. This statement does not exempt the private wheel library or other PCRE packages.

x_extra_codeowners_runtime.review: Reviewed blocking-check refresh and missing-check invalidation optimization, including the known-peer discovery fallback. The SQL union reads queued and completed PR identities only to decide whether fresh GitHub discovery is needed; it uses no SQLite FTS or native extension. No native-library entry points, FFI, subprocesses, or attacker-controlled scanf formats are introduced. The recorded package reachability conclusions remain valid.
